author: The Infographics Show
description:
For decades, we've been told the United States has the most powerful military on Earth. But what if one of its biggest weaknesses has been hiding in plain sight? Unknown drones repeatedly breached one of America's most heavily protected air bases, Congress still can't access dozens of classified UAP videos, and the Pentagon continues to offer more questions than answers. The truth may have nothing to do with aliens, and everything to do with vulnerabilities America's adversaries already understand.

This video examines the mysterious Langley drone incursions, the Pentagon's classified UAP footage, David Grusch's explosive testimony, the Gimbal video controversy, electronic warfare, radar spoofing, and the growing challenge posed by advanced Chinese drone and hypersonic technology.
